_metadata.title: ComplianceLint Interim Standard for EU AI Act Article 52: Notification of GPAI Models with Systemic Risk
_metadata.disclaimer: This is an interim checklist developed by ComplianceLint. It is not a harmonised standard and does not itself give a presumption of conformity. No harmonised standard is requested for Article 52; Article 52 is in Chapter V, Section 1. Article 52(4) empowers the Commission to adopt delegated acts amending the criteria in Annex XIII.
_metadata.awaiting_standard: No harmonised standard is requested for Article 52; Article 52 is in Chapter V, Section 1. Article 52(4) empowers the Commission to adopt delegated acts amending the criteria in Annex XIII.

requirements.title: Timely Notification to Commission
requirements.requirement: The provider MUST notify the Commission without delay and no later than 2 weeks after the GPAI model meets the systemic risk criteria.
requirements.rationale: Art. 52(1) mandates notification within 2 weeks of meeting classification criteria.
acceptable_implementations: Formal notification letter submitted to EU AI Office within 14 days
Automated threshold monitoring with notification trigger workflow
Compliance calendar with notification deadline tracking

requirements.title: Notification Content Completeness
requirements.requirement: The notification under Article 52(1) MUST include the information necessary to demonstrate that the condition of Article 51(1), point (a), has been met.
requirements.rationale: Art. 52(1), second sentence: 'That notification shall include the information necessary to demonstrate that the relevant requirement has been met.'
acceptable_implementations: Notification package with FLOPs calculation and training documentation
Structured notification form with capability assessment results
Comprehensive submission with model card and technical specifications

requirements.title: Arguments Against Classification (Optional)
requirements.requirement: A provider that considers its model does not present systemic risks despite meeting Article 51(1)(a) MAY submit sufficiently substantiated arguments with the notification under Article 52(1), relying on the model's specific characteristics (Article 52(2)).
requirements.rationale: Art. 52(2) lets the provider 'present, with its notification, sufficiently substantiated arguments to demonstrate that, exceptionally, although it meets that requirement, the general-purpose AI model does not present, due to its specific characteristics, systemic risks'. It does not require the provider to prepare such arguments.
acceptable_implementations: Documented rebuttal case with technical evidence of limited capability scope
Independent assessment report supporting non-systemic-risk classification
Structured argumentation framework aligned with Annex XIII criteria

scoring.compliant: R01 + R02 met, R03 if applicable
